description: This file defines a specification class for querying a customer by its unique identifier (Id) in a read-only manner using the Ardalis.Specification pattern.

classes.name: CustomerByIdSpec
classes.description: A specification class for retrieving a single customer by Id in a read-only, no-tracking query context.

methods.name: CustomerByIdSpec(Guid id)
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the query to fetch a customer by the specified Id with AsNoTracking for optimized read-only access.
